scope.purpose: Evidence collection attempt and evidence-policy record; no natural evidence or production implementation; synthetic harness evidence is not a natural substitute
scope.runtime_changes: NO PRODUCTION RUNTIME; synthetic capture harness remains non-production
scope.p0_01_p0_02_contract: Unchanged; alpha.15 revision, opaque 16-byte ID encoding, golden values, and notary_time exclusion remain frozen

evidence_policy.natural_source: ordinary FUSOU-APP startup and gameplay through the supported Game Client and an allowlisted Game Server
prohibited_sources: retry of a forwarded logical request
evidence_policy.capture_behavior: passive observation of an existing client-facing TLS plaintext session; the harness never creates the request
evidence_policy.collection_mode: manual controlled observation with private raw storage and recorded privacy review
evidence_policy.ci_policy: CI may validate synthetic harness artifacts and previously sanitized fixtures, but cannot create or auto-pass natural provenance
evidence_policy.trigger_knowledge: The repository does not identify the exact ordinary gameplay action that first causes require_info

synthetic_harness_evidence.scope: Generated CONNECT/TLS traffic proves the hook, directional exact-wire ranges, lifecycle handling, and no-retry behavior
does_not_satisfy: privacy review of a real client session

capture.reason: No authorized natural capture from ordinary FUSOU-APP gameplay was supplied or available for this run

proxy_observed_facts.fact: Collects the hyper request body and reconstructs the request body before forwarding
Records method, derived path, content type, and a body representation; API request persistence is enabled only by the allow_save_api_requests configuration
Saved kcsapi request files prepend local metadata and do not preserve the raw request line, complete headers, transfer framing, or transcript offsets
Collects the hyper response body and reconstructs the response body before forwarding
The logging path can decode gzip, deflate, and brotli, so the saved representation is not an authenticated raw transcript
In-process messages contain path, content_type, and String content only; they do not contain status, headers, raw bytes, or request/response boundaries

require_info_repository_facts.fact: The repository DTO models api_data.api_basic.api_member_id as i64; this is a source/DTO fact and not a natural wire capture
The DTO tests load external TEST_DATA_PATH and TEST_DATA_REPO_PATH values; neither variable was configured for this run

fixture_generation_procedure.natural_source_requirement: The exchange must arise from ordinary FUSOU-APP gameplay; no standalone request or capture-triggered traffic may be used
required_inputs: An authorized supported Game Client build and controlled session
The FUSOU proxy configured to retain a privacy-reviewed raw capture
A collector that records raw request/response bytes and boundaries before any decoding
fixture_generation_procedure.prohibited_substitute: Do not generate a local mock request, synthetic response, simulator fixture, replay, or injected request and label it natural

privacy.disposition: No secret-bearing material was collected. A future natural capture requires redaction review before repository storage; hashing alone is not a substitute for removing sensitive bytes

p0_05_authenticated_disclosure.gate_independence: A qualifying natural capture is necessary input provenance but does not by itself prove TLSNotary alpha.15 verification, authenticated disclosure, exact ranges, digest, binding validation, or strict Result construction

adapter_boundary.backend_behavior: verify_alpha15_presentation strictly decodes, verifies, and maps a frozen alpha.15 Presentation

upstream_fixture.verification_command: cargo test -p tlsn-attestation --features fixtures --test no_syscall_verify test_verify_presentation_without_syscalls -- --exact
upstream_fixture.qualification: REAL_ALPHA15_VERIFICATION; upstream Presentation verification only; it is not a FUSOU require_info request/response disclosure fixture

strict_negative_matrix.authority_parser_status: A strict Result/transcript parser and sealed alpha15 adapter exist at packages/FUSOU-TLSN-VERIFIER; tests cover real upstream Presentation verification, modified/truncated/trailing/invalid Presentation bytes, modified transcript bytes, modified ranges, partial disclosure, wrong identity, and canonical Result flow. The upstream fixture is not FUSOU require_info evidence; production identity authority and FUSOU authenticated disclosure remain NOT_OBTAINED

not_upstream_guarantees: FUSOU require_info HTTP framing and exact target validation
X-FUSOU-Attestation-Binding placement, cardinality, and session matching
FUSOU strict parser, digest, and range acceptance
one logical Game request and no Game Server re-submission
upstream_boundary.adapter_rule: FUSOU adapter owns these validations and must not describe adapter-added fields as Notary-signed

no_resubmission.contract: The existing no Game Server re-submission contract is unchanged
no_resubmission.retry_classification: No runtime retry path was added or exercised

reproduction.upstream_verification: The package-level alpha.15 backend test verifies the 5394-byte upstream fixture and remains valid as REAL_ALPHA15_VERIFICATION only
reproduction.natural_capture_reproduction: Requires an authorized supported Game Client used through ordinary FUSOU-APP gameplay, an allowlisted Game Server, and a privacy-approved passive raw capture collector; no standalone request, replay, injection, or run is claimed by this artifact
